name: elgato-mic-picker
description: Stream Deck plugin for macOS: one key per microphone. Press to make it the default input; press again to mute/unmute.
author: Robert Wayne (https://github.com/RobertTheNerd)

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:js
scripts.build:native: mkdir -p build && swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos12 native/micctl.swift -o build/micctl-arm64 && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macos12 native/micctl.swift -o build/micctl-x86_64 && lipo -create build/micctl-arm64 build/micctl-x86_64 -output com.robert.mic-picker.sdPlugin/bin/micctl
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run validate
scripts.restart: pkill -f com.robert.mic-picker.sdPlugin/bin/plugin.js; echo 'Stream Deck relaunches the plugin automatically'
scripts.pack: npm run build && mkdir -p dist && streamdeck pack com.robert.mic-picker.sdPlugin --output dist --force
